response.original_title: Complete Guide-How do i add a passenger on a Carnival Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing reservation, you must call Carnival Customer Service directly at +1-866-829-1280 or contact your travel agent. The new guest must fit within the maximum allowed occupancy of your current stateroom. If you booked through a travel agent, +1-866-829-1280 they legally own the reservation and must make the changes for you. Required Info: Have your booking number, the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and Captain’s Circle number ready when you call. To add passengers to a Carnival Cruise, you must call Carnival Cruise directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online.
